In 1981, Pope Cottage was relocated to 3974 North Dakota Avenue, where it served as a residence hall before eventually being demolished to make way for a new home.

Norton House was intentionally burned for demolition in 1983.
Osborn Cottage was demolished in 2001 after hosting the Honors Program for 25 years.
